newsitem.title: UK: Airtours soars on Italian cruise buy plan.
newsitem.headline: Airtours soars on Italian cruise buy plan.

text.p: Shares in Airtours Plc soared to a record high on Thursday, after the holiday operator said with partner Carnival Corp it planned to buy Italian cruise line Costa Crociere SpA for 181 million stg.
Airtours stock was up 39p to 786-1/2p by 0919 GMT, in modest volume of 333,304 shares.

Traders said the acquisition was seen as a good deal for Airtours and that the shares -- which have almost doubled in the past five months -- had been squeezed higher amid a shortage of stock in the market.
"It looks like a good price, it is a good deal for Airtours," said one market-maker.
Airtours has been going from strength to strength since the beginning of the year. "There is a lot of positive news around," said one trader.

The latest surge in Airtours shares was sparked by record profits announced in early December that oustripped analysts' forecasts. The company said it was in a position to spend between 200 and 250 million stg on acquisitions.
